# Monster lifecycle source fixture

Original Journey AGPL source from the verified client-source manifest used for
the 573ff2e build (upstream bc0234fe7c7f53322453e7bdd79564d9aca4cd8b
plus existing patches). 0015 does not change these files. SHA256.json binds the
exact pre-0016 bytes; upstream license notices remain intact. No game assets,
credentials or runtime evidence are included. The test also reuses the existing
client-magic-damage/Mob.cpp fixture for actual kill/is_alive method bodies.
